title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: CD -> EAC(secure, offset corrected) -> CoolEdit Pro -> TLH -> FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1970 Fillmore East soundboard capture featuring an epic Dark Star, a China‑Cat‑laden Not Fade Away and unforgettable Pigpen banter.
ai_review.review: The SBD from September 9‑10 1970 at the Fillmore East sounds astonishingly clean – listeners rave about its crisp mix despite some minor speed quirks. Musically the show is legendary, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star, a unique Not Fade Away with China‑Cat and “darkness” jams, plus standout moments from St. Stephen, Lovelight and Pigpen’s final Good Morning, School Girl. Jerry’s guitar, Phil’s bass foundation and Mickey’s drumming receive consistent praise, making this one of the most celebrated 1970 recordings.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 50 reviews overwhelmingly rate the show and recording five stars; only a few outliers lower the average slightly, yielding a strong combined performance‑plus‑recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is crisp and clear with very low noise; reviewers note occasional speed/pitch wobble in sections but overall the SBD is considered superb and highly listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set builds smoothly into a second‑set marathon; the Dark Star opens the night and segues into a legendary Not Fade Away with China‑Cat teases, followed by a tight St. Stephen/NFA sequence and a heartfelt Pigpen finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for “perfect” tone, soaring leads on Dark Star and overall guitar brilliance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as carrying the day with solid bass foundation; one reviewer says Phil really shines on this performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: His rhythm playing is highlighted as jaw‑dropping, especially during the China‑Cat jam and later jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s drumming (including his “cannon” effect) receives specific admiration for adding texture to the jams.
